note_en: Notice 被用来 in 现在被用来形容…: literally "is used to describe." Chinese often uses 被 without saying who does the action, much like an English passive with no "by" phrase. Also note 用来 + verb, "used for doing": 用它调侃自己 "use it to make fun of themselves" shows the active version.
